title: GST Return Forms: Public Consultation Opening November 1, 2026!
content:
# GST Return Forms: Public Consultation Opening November 1, 2026!

Ek important update hai for all GST taxpayers and professionals! The Finance Ministry is all set to open public consultation for revamped Goods and Services Tax (GST) return forms starting November 1, 2026. This move aims to streamline the return filing process and address common issues like mismatches in tax liability and Input Tax Credit (ITC) claims.

Here's a quick lowdown:
*   **What's Happening?** The government will be inviting public comments on proposed changes to monthly GST return forms, specifically GSTR-1, GSTR-1A, and the Invoice Furnishing Facility (IFF).
*   **Why the Change?** The primary objective is to minimise mismatches between GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, thereby reducing the number of notices and intimations sent to taxpayers due to discrepancies. This initiative also seeks to resolve integrity issues in the ITC chain.
*   **Consultation Period:** The draft forms will be available on the MyGov portal for public feedback from **November 1, 2026, to November 30, 2026**.
*   **Origin of Proposal:** These enhancements were approved during the 57th meeting of the GST Council, held on October 8, 2026.
*   **Effective Date:** The revised forms are planned to be applicable from **April 1, 2027**.

This is a crucial opportunity for businesses and practitioners to provide their valuable input and help shape a more efficient GST return system.
